source.title: On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling
source.reading_method: Independently read the primary HTML, Section 2, Sections 3-4 and Appendices A-C before reading the added site-model case. No implementation Lean or coordinator theorem summary was used to reconstruct the source routes.

truth_boundary.scope: Source statement, proof-route, method-comparison and source-inconsistency audit only. This is neither a theorem-completion certificate nor an exhaustive semantic-roundtrip audit.

model_seal.precision_class: A real symmetric d-by-d; I_d <= A <= kappa I_d; target N(0,A^(-1)).
model_seal.oracle: Exact x -> Ax. For f_A(x)=x^T A x/2 this is equivalent to exact (f_A(x), grad f_A(x)), and also gradient-only access, because f_A(x)=<x,Ax>/2.
model_seal.algorithms: Queries and stopping decisions are Borel functions of an input-independent seed and previous responses. Output is an arbitrary R^d-valued Borel function of the same information. Both adaptive and randomized algorithms are covered.
model_seal.output_restriction: No query-span or query/reply-span restriction. Lemma 4.3 explicitly needs an additional Gaussian start for the output.
model_seal.budget_quantifier: There exists an integer T >= 0 and one algorithm making at most T queries for EVERY admissible input and EVERY seed realization. T is a deterministic worst-case cap, not an expected query budget.
model_seal.accuracy_quantifier: sup_A TV(rho_A^Alg, pi_A) <= epsilon, where rho_A^Alg already averages all internal randomness. No per-seed accuracy is asserted.
model_seal.tv_normalization: sup over measurable B of |P(B)-Q(B)| = one half of density L1 distance.
forbidden_unrecorded_changes: Replace deterministic cap by expected cost.
Restrict outputs to the query/reply span.
Replace uniform-in-input accuracy by an average-prior guarantee as the public theorem.
Assume exact spectrum is known in the determinant-sign theorem.
Add derived transcript, separation, concentration, tau/beta or moment estimates as public theorem binders.

main_statement_seals.quantifiers: For every integer d >= 1, every real kappa >= 4 and every 0 < epsilon <= 1/16.
main_statement_seals.boundary: Uniform all-dimensional accuracy-sensitive lower bound in the exact-oracle deterministic-cap model. The sign is det(O), not det(A); A is positive definite. The source does not establish an expected-budget analogue here.

main_statement_seals.quantifiers: For every fixed delta in (0,1), there exists d_0(delta), such that for every integer d >= d_0(delta), every real 2 <= kappa <= d^(1-delta), and every 0 < epsilon <= 1/10.
main_statement_seals.spectrum_contract: For each (d,kappa), theta_i=(i-1/2)pi/d and lambda_i=(kappa+1)/2+(kappa-1)cos(theta_i)/2 are deterministic; A=O Lambda O^T, O Haar independent of the algorithm seed. Lambda and the normalizing constant may be supplied. This is a particular hard fixed spectrum, not a claim that every supplied spectrum is hard.
main_statement_seals.boundary: The dimension threshold depends only on delta, uniformly over kappa and epsilon in the stated ranges. The lower bound has no growing precision term.

determinant_route.content: A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T), with k=floor(d/n) blocks and an identity remainder. Under each fixed sign b the O_j are independent with law mu_(n,b). One FO call costs at most two primitive O_j/O_j^T observations PER block.
Orthogonality and Cauchy-Schwarz bound <v,Ov>; sum quadratic forms over blocks. Obtain spectral bounds and known unique minimizer 0.

For residual dimension m>=2, Wu has uniform spherical law under either determinant component, and the conditional residual map is component-conditioned Haar. Borel SO frames retain the determinant label.
Posterior factorization of residual maps survives adaptive forward/inverse observations, including cross-block query dependence and zero residual vectors. Before a new observation m>=n-2T+1>=2.

Iterate sign-independent Borel response kernels on padded histories, then integrate the independent seed and push forward by arbitrary Borel output. For 2T<n, the two averaged output laws agree exactly.

determinant_route.anchor: Lemma B.6, Proposition B.7, Lemma A.1
determinant_route.content: Factor A_O as C^T C/4 and control the determinant sign of C by continuity. Haar row-reflection cancels all principal minors except empty and {1}. Conjugation invariance, dominated Fubini and Gaussian integration reduce a bounded radial exponential test to two spherical Poisson integrals. This produces TV(P_+,P_-) >= (1/2) exp(-5n/sqrt(kappa)).

For each fixed sign the target mixture is a product across blocks. TV <= sqrt(1-affinity^2), affinity tensorization and TV >= 1-affinity give TV(bar_pi_+,bar_pi_-) >= 1-exp(-(k/8)exp(-10n/sqrt(kappa))).

Separate T=0 and 2T+1>d. Otherwise choose n=2T+1>=3. Admissibility, uniform input accuracy, mixing convexity and equal output laws give TV(bar_pi_+,bar_pi_-)<=2epsilon. Invert to k exp(-10n/sqrt(kappa))<=32epsilon, use k>=d/(2n), n<=3T, sinh(t)>=t and log concavity. The interior calculation gives coefficient 1/192; the published final bound uses 1/256.

eigenbasis_route.content: Cosine-grid eigenvalues are distinct and in (1,kappa). Orthogonal conjugation preserves bounds. Only O is hidden; determinant and Gaussian normalizer are public with Lambda.

An enlarged history reveals O on a latent subspace E; its restriction between complementary spaces stays a full Haar isometry. Auxiliary randomness and image/preimage revelation preserve this invariant.

For q>=0 with 2q+1<d, a joint-law-preserving extension creates q+1 mutually independent standard Gaussian starts. Gaussianize newly revealed uniform directions. Propagate latent spans under Lambda and treat X as a final preimage revelation. Obtain O^T X in K_q=span{Lambda^j g_a:a<=q+1,j<=q} almost surely. The g_a need not be independent of O or X; coefficients may depend on the whole extension.

n=2q+1. Chebyshev change of basis and finite cosine sums give E(B^T B)=I, E(B^T D_n B)=0. Gaussian truncation, bias control, fourth moments and matrix Bernstein give simultaneous Gram bounds. With absolute C, tau=C[(q+1)sqrt(log(d)/d)+(q+1)(q+1+log(d))log(d)/d]. If 2q+1<d and tau<=1/2, with probability >=0.99 every u in K_q satisfies |u^T D_n u|<=2tau||u||^2.

Set rho=(sqrt(kappa)-1)/(sqrt(kappa)+1), U~N(0,Lambda^(-1)), M=E||U||^2, mu_n=E(U^T D_n U). For 1<=n<d, M=(d/sqrt(kappa))(1-rho^(2d))/(1+rho^(2d)) and (-1)^n mu_n=(d/sqrt(kappa))(rho^n-rho^(2d-n))/(1+rho^(2d)). Both variances <=2M. If d-n>=sqrt(kappa), (1-exp(-4))exp(-3n/sqrt(kappa))<=|mu_n|/M<=exp(-2n/sqrt(kappa)). Dependencies: absolutely uniformly convergent cosine series, finite-grid aliasing, Gaussian fourth moments and elementary rho bounds.

Assume q<=(delta/256)sqrt(kappa)log(d). Choose d_0(delta) uniformly so n<d, d-n>=sqrt(kappa), tau<=beta/4 and M beta^2>=320, beta=|mu_n|/M. The input-dependent Chebyshev-polynomial event has algorithm average probability <=0.01, target probability >=0.9 by variance bound and Chebyshev. Uniform per-input TV gives 0.89<=epsilon<=0.1, contradiction. E_A is an analysis witness, not a sampler oracle query.

The same enlarged space generically has dimension min{d,(q+1)^2}; once full it cannot have uniformly small high-frequency quadratic form. Separately, the Bernstein-certified uniform noise floor and exponentially decaying target bias cap this test at q=O(sqrt(kappa)log(d)), without growing dependence on epsilon.

independent_source_proof_graph.coverage_boundary: Major source proof dependencies reconstructed; full paragraph/display/citation coverage, explicit external-leaf contracts, all analytic measurability certificates and Lean Statement Seals remain pending. Lemma 4.7 is stated without a proof in this HTML; a future formal proof must supply its generic-rank/Vandermonde argument rather than invent a source appendix.

section_4_4_audit.kappa_boundary: This uniform-Krylov-space argument cannot extend the sqrt(kappa)log(d) rate into kappa of order d/log(d)^2 or above, because at the corresponding q scale (q+1)^2 reaches d. This is distinct from the positively proved kappa<=d^(1-delta) range.
section_4_4_audit.dimension: Almost surely dim K_q=min{d,(q+1)^2}; with K_q=R^d and n<d, some coordinate has |cos(n theta_i)|>=1/sqrt(2). A small uniform operator ratio therefore fails.
section_4_4_audit.accuracy_boundary: For this threshold test one needs a < beta, while the specific Bernstein certification needs a>=c/sqrt(d) and beta<=exp(-2(2q+1)/sqrt(kappa)). Inverting gives q=O(sqrt(kappa)log(d)) irrespective of epsilon. Do not turn this certification limitation into a universal noise-floor theorem for every possible proof.
not_established: No impossibility theorem for stronger lower bounds on the same fixed-spectrum family.
No impossibility theorem for all other test statistics or smaller representations.
No theorem that Gaussian sampling itself loses its precision dependence.

conceptual_comparison.mechanism: Adaptive finite revelation preserves residual rotational uncertainty; unrevealed directions limit what outputs can encode.

hypothesis_map.determinant_route: Product of determinant-conditioned Haar laws per block, SO Borel frames, fewer than n primitive revelations per block and residual dimension at least two before an observation.
hypothesis_map.eigenbasis_route: Single full-Haar eigenbasis with public distinct Lambda, Haar-isometry state, enlarged probability space preserving the original joint law, 2q+1<d and q+1 Gaussian starts.

conclusion_map.determinant_route: Exact equality of two prior-averaged transcript/output laws.
conclusion_map.eigenbasis_route: Almost-sure span containment for one input ensemble, followed by a uniform random-space inequality.

conceptual_comparison.failure_boundary: These are different propositions and different priors. Do not identify sign-conditional posterior factorization with full-Haar Krylov representation. Do not identify radial mixture separation with an A-dependent cosine test. Any future common Haar kernel must be independently proved with explicit component, dimension, conditional-law and measurability adapters.
candidate_shared_substrate: Actual exact probability/TV, Borel-kernel composition and Gaussian linear-image declarations may be shared only after declaration-level contract checks.
Haar revelation may motivate a shared abstraction, but no existing compiled common theorem has been reviewed here.

source_inconsistencies.finding: The conclusion first claims matching when kappa<=d^(2-delta), then calls closing the constant-accuracy gap for that same regime open. Those statements cannot both describe the same claim. Preserve the discrepancy and privilege the exact theorem/derived regime; do not silently rewrite the source open problem.

anchors: Section 1.1 sentence after the kappa<=d^(2-delta) matching statement
source_inconsistencies.finding: The introduction asserts confirmation of the sqrt(kappa)log(d) conjecture throughout sqrt(kappa)log(d)<=d. The explicit lower bound does not imply this whole region.
source_inconsistencies.independent_diagnostic: At fixed epsilon in (0,1/16], set kappa=d^2/(log(d))^2 for large d. Then sqrt(kappa)log(d)=d, but the Theorem 3.1 right-hand scale is Theta(d log(log(d))/log(d)), whereas the cited conjectured scale is d. This identifies a logical overclaim in the exposition, not a counterexample to either the main theorem or the conjecture.
source_inconsistencies.recommended_reader_action: Display the exact proven formula and fixed-delta matching regimes. Flag the broader conjecture-confirmation wording as unsupported by this formula; retain it as attributed source text only.

source_inconsistencies.finding: The statement contains both an opening n>=2 and a trailing n>=3 qualification. The determinant application uses n=2T+1>=3, so it is unaffected. A generic n=2 leaf requires its own statement seal; do not erase the discrepancy.

site_model_comparison_after_independent_.verdict: Main formulas, constants, quantifiers, deterministic-cap model, output freedom, fixed-spectrum meaning and conceptual separation agree with the independently read source at the intake-outline level.

corrections_or_expansions.request: Add GC-v1-conjecture-confirmation-overclaim from this review; the two currently recorded discrepancies do not cover it.

Include the formula for tau_(d,q), the q>=0 and 2q+1<d side conditions, and that the bound is simultaneous over every u. The overview correctly labels itself nonexhaustive, but tau is currently used without being defined.
Add eigen-uniform -> eigen-limits: Section 4.4 uses the uniform-space estimate and Fact C.6 Bernstein certification, in addition to representation and target moments.

Generic Krylov dimension saturation belongs to the limitations branch. Lemma 4.4's positive proof instead uses cosine basis identities plus Gram concentration and Gram lower coercivity; do not make Lemma 4.7 a proof parent of Lemma 4.4.
